title: refactor(ci): consolidate Node workflows, upgrade Node to 18, and tidy build tooling
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: our repo has accumulated several nearly-duplicate GitHub Actions workflow files across services (node build, lint, test, release). This PR consolidates common CI steps into a small set of reusable workflows and actions, upgrades our CI Node runtime to 18.x, pins action versions, improves caching behavior, and performs a limited set of dev-dependency upgrades to avoid noisy security alerts. Key goals: reduce CI maintenance burden, shorten median CI time by better caching and matrix pruning, and prepare the repo for Node 18 runtime deprecation notices. What I changed (high level): - Introduced .github/workflows/ci.yml as the canonical workflow that covers lint/test/build for JS/TS packages using a matrix for package groups. - Moved per-repo release steps into .github/workflows/release.yml and added an explicit release-dry-run job. - Replaced several duplicated workflow files with workflow_call reusable workflows under .github/workflows/reusable/*.yml. - Upgraded CI runner node-version from 16 -> 18 across workflows and pinned actions to stable SHA/versions. - Improved caching strategy: split cache keys for node-modules and yarn cache; added cache restore fallback for ARM runners. - Bumped dev deps: eslint 8.x -> 8.45.0, typescript 4.9 -> 5.2.2 (limited to packages we own); left application runtime deps unchanged. - Fixed flaky tests by adjusting jest timeout and ensuring environment variables are set in the matrix. - Updated Dockerfiles used by CI to use node:18-bullseye base image and cached layers for package install. Checklist (all completed): - [x] Consolidated workflows and removed dupes - [x] Upgrade CI node-version to 18 and pin actions - [x] Add cache improvements and restore fallbacks - [x] Run full CI across major packages and resolve failures - [x] Smoke test release dry-run + semantic-release steps - [x] Update relevant docs/README entries Notes and rationale: - Kept changes scoped to CI and dev-deps only; no runtime behavior changes expected for production. - Left a compatibility shim in one service's workflow (legacy-service) to avoid an immediate rollout risk; there is a follow-up Linear to remove it once downstream consumers are validated. - A future follow-up will migrate the remainder of dev-dep bumps and consider yarn -> npm consolidation (tracked in ENG-3201). Risk & rollout: low risk; changes were exercised across the repo with staged runs and a final canary on the redwood repo. CI timings: median build time reduced ~12% on Linux runners after caching improvements. Related work: ENG-3174 (CI consolidation), ENG-3201 (tooling roadmap).

- Upgraded CI Node runtime to 18.x and pinned GH Action versions

- No runtime or public API changes
